literal_gloss: I-read the four books of-Origen On Principles. In the first concerning Father and Son and Holy Spirit: blasphemous many, as the Son by the Father to-be-created, the Spirit by the Son; the Father all to-distinguish, the Son the rational, the Spirit the saved. In the second concerning world and created-things: the of-the Law and prophets God one and the same of-the new and old Covenants. In the third concerning free-will: how the devil and the opposing powers against the men fight. In the fourth concerning end, God-breathed-ness of-Scripture, and correct reading.
lemmas: κτισθῆναι (to be created - aorist passive infinitive)
